title: mut.seed_channel
mutation_directive: Channel Chiharu Shiota's web-network DNA from chiharu-shiota-skill SKILL.md (red taut LINE SEGMENTS — never points, never curves; one suspended object as the still center; black void background; architectural in-the-web camera; presence-in-absence as concept). PERFORMANCE BUDGET (HARD): no more than 20,000 line segments total (a single THREE.LineSegments BufferGeometry, two vertices each = 40,000 position floats × 3). Use THREE.LineSegments + LineBasicMaterial ONLY (additive blending, opacity 0.04-0.10, single red hue ~#c20018) — DO NOT use ShaderMaterial on the threads (it has caused render-gate timeouts). The suspended sphere should be a single THREE.Mesh with SphereGeometry(radius, 24, 16) + MeshBasicMaterial OR MeshStandardMaterial (white/cream, ~0.6 emissive intensity if standard). NO custom ShaderMaterial on the sphere either. The camera slowly dollies INSIDE the network on a gentle path — not orbiting from outside. NO noise-driven motion on threads — they're static or breathe via tiny anchor jitter (<0.5% length variation). Pieces from this seed live on a separate aesthetic branch from attractors / boids / differential growth — they're INSTALLATIONS, not simulations. The piece must produce a clearly visible (>5% non-background pixels) screenshot within 5 seconds of load — if the line count or shader complexity prevents that, scale down.

refik_anadol.praise: The 20,000-segment budget fills architectural volume convincingly — the four-category density distribution (wall-to-wall, convergent, local, wrapping) creates a legitimate sense of data-as-atmosphere radiating from that pale sphere.
refik_anadol.concern: The fog decay at 0.032 plus opacity 0.04-0.10 may dissolve distant threads into nothing, collapsing perceived depth to a small bubble around the sphere rather than the room-scale immersion the piece title promises. Two home countries should feel vast.
refik_anadol.directive: Reduce fog density to ~0.018 and boost distant wall-thread opacity to 0.08 so the full 32-unit room reads as inhabited space.

sasha_stiles.praise: The title 'two home countries' gives the suspended sphere genuine weight — it becomes a body held between geographies, and the converging threads read as the taut grammar of belonging. The sphere is a word; the threads are its etymology.
sasha_stiles.concern: There is no second anchor. Two home countries implies a duality — a tension between two poles — but the composition is radially symmetric around one center. The language of the title isn't yet earned by the spatial form.
sasha_stiles.directive: Add a second smaller suspended object offset from the sphere — even a ghost outline — to embody the 'two' in the title.

entangled_others.praise: The four thread categories mimic vascular morphology beautifully — Category D's tight arterial wrapping around the sphere reads like capillary beds around an organ, and Category B's convergent threads feel like nutrient flow toward a central body.
entangled_others.concern: The system is entirely static. Biological networks breathe, pulse, redistribute. The anchor jitter budget (0.5% length variation) is allowed but unused in the visible code — the threads are frozen specimens rather than living tissue.
entangled_others.directive: Implement the permitted anchor jitter as a slow systolic pulse (period ~8s) radiating outward from the sphere center.

olafur_eliasson.praise: The camera dollying inside the network is correct — the viewer is participant, not observer. The single red hue against near-black creates a mono-frequency condition reminiscent of sodium-lamp atmospherics where depth is perceived through density alone.
olafur_eliasson.concern: The lighting setup (ambient + directional + point) is utilitarian — it illuminates the sphere but doesn't treat light as a material that the threads interact with. The red threads should catch and scatter light differently at different depths, creating atmospheric strata.
olafur_eliasson.directive: Add a single slow-cycling point light near the sphere that pulses warmth outward, making thread density visible as luminous fog layers.

chiharu_shiota.praise: This is respectful. Straight line segments, single red hue, black void, one suspended pale object at the center, camera inside the web — the structural grammar is correct. The convergent threads toward the sphere create the gravitational pull of memory I recognize.
chiharu_shiota.concern: The sphere is too perfect, too geometric. My suspended objects are REMEMBERED things — a dress, a key, a burned piano. A pristine SphereGeometry reads as abstract mathematics, not as something once held by hands. It has no biography.
chiharu_shiota.directive: Deform the sphere subtly — displace vertices along noise so it reads as a worn, imperfect object that once belonged to someone.
